      display: flex;

      justify-content: center;
      overflow: hidden;

    #stage {
      width: 90vw;
      max-height: 90vh;

</svg>

<script>
  const svg       = document.getElementById('stage');
  const textGroup = document.getElementById('text-group');

  // viewBox start / end
  const START_W = 1031;
  const END_W   = 2239;
  const HEIGHT  = 1024;

  // Timing
  const HOLD_MS     = 700;   // pause on logo before expanding
  const EXPAND_MS   = 1400;  // viewBox expansion duration
  const TEXT_DELAY  = 300;   // text starts fading in N ms after expansion begins
  const TEXT_MS     = 900;   // text fade-in duration

  // Cubic-bezier ease-out (approximated)
  function easeOutCubic(t) {
    return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
  }

  function easeInOutQuad(t) {
    return t < 0.5 ? 2 * t * t : -1 + (4 - 2 * t) * t;
  }

  let origin = null;

  function frame(now) {
    if (origin === null) origin = now;
    const elapsed = now - origin;

    // ── viewBox expansion ──
    const expandElapsed = elapsed - HOLD_MS;
    if (expandElapsed >= 0) {
      const t = Math.min(expandElapsed / EXPAND_MS, 1);
      const e = easeOutCubic(t);
      const w = START_W + (END_W - START_W) * e;
      svg.setAttribute('viewBox', `0 0 ${w.toFixed(1)} ${HEIGHT}`);
    }

    // ── text fade-in ──
    const textElapsed = elapsed - HOLD_MS - TEXT_DELAY;
    if (textElapsed >= 0) {
      const t = Math.min(textElapsed / TEXT_MS, 1);
      const opacity = easeInOutQuad(t);
      textGroup.setAttribute('opacity', opacity.toFixed(4));
    }

    if (elapsed < HOLD_MS + EXPAND_MS) {
      requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    } else {
      // Snap to final state
      svg.setAttribute('viewBox', `0 0 ${END_W} ${HEIGHT}`);
      textGroup.setAttribute('opacity', '1');
    }
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
</body>
</html>
